title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode8 Playing with Lions!

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaargh!!!
It won't stop chasing me!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Somebody help me! My legs are about to give out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hang in there, Tsukasa!
Help's on the way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then let's begin Operation Lion Capture!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My goodness, Emu! You were born to make mochi!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! I got praised by Miku!
Let's make the most delicious mochi ever☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Lion Dance Robot! Wanna help us make mochi?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad you've become such good friends with the Lion Dance Robot. It was worth staying up all night working on it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's so lifelike. It's unbelievable!
But why did you decide to make it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I wanted to make a robot to go along with the time of year.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I cloned Robo-Nene's operating system, but its AI is original and lets it move autonomously.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow! Um, that sounds so high tech! But it's a really cool robot, nonetheless!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry, but can someone help us out?
I need someone to help cut mochi cakes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm happy to help!
Let's do it together♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's great to see everyone so happy and full of energy on New Year's Day!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. It's a nice time to just relax. Lately, I've been stuck thinking up ideas for a new show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're working on a new show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Miku found this gigantic net and wanted to use it for a performance, but I'm having trouble finding a way to include it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, where did you get the mochi mortar and mallet from? Looks like they've already been used quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that was all Emu.
She found them in a storehouse at her house.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa, what do you want?
Weren't you making mochi with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I think it likes you, Tsukasa.
Maybe try playing with it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
With me? Well, okay...
I can play with it for a bit if...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oww! Cut it out!
Hey, don't chew on my head!
Stop it or I won't play with you!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, great!
We're almost done here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Okay, one last push!
Whaaam!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh oh, the mallet flew out of Emu's hands!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the...?! Why's there a mallet flying towards me...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Lion Dance Robot! We have to move or...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nooo!!! I'm so sorry, Lion Dance Robot!
I let the mallet fly out of my hands and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Lion Dance Robot?
It's gone all quiet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is it broken...?
Rui, can you take a look and...?
